findings.evidence: `tracePart_apply` (line 80) is `(trace (g⁻¹ * T) / Fintype.card n) • g`; in a field `div_zero` makes this `0 • g = 0` when the cast card is `0`. The file already argues the analogous degenerate case for `g` at lines 104–106 (`nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit`).
findings.fix: Drop `hn` from all six and open each proof with `rcases eq_or_ne (Fintype.card n : K) 0 with hn | hn`, closing the first branch by `simp [tracePart_apply, hn]` (resp. `tracelessPart_apply`) and keeping the current proof in the second; `isIdempotentElem_*` then follow unconditionally.
findings.issue: `hn : (Fintype.card n : K) ≠ 0` is unnecessary in `tracePart_tracePart` (144), `tracePart_tracelessPart` (150), `tracelessPart_tracePart` (156), `tracelessPart_tracelessPart` (162), `isIdempotentElem_tracePart` (167) and `isIdempotentElem_tracelessPart` (172). When `(card n : K) = 0`, `tracePart_apply` gives `tracePart g T = (trace (g⁻¹ * T) / 0) • g = 0` by `div_zero`/`zero_smul`, so `tracePart g` is the zero map and `tracelessPart g` the identity: all six statements hold. Four are `@[simp]`, so the needless side condition must be discharged at every rewrite.

findings.evidence: `EpsilonEridani/QFT/QCD/EnergyMomentumTensor/QuarkPart.lean:302` `theorem trace_quarkPart` and `:312` `theorem trace_quarkPart_of_diracEq`; the PR's proof at line 100 is `rw [tracePart_apply, trace_quarkPart_of_diracEq hg hγ h]`, i.e. it goes through the special case only.
findings.fix: Add `tracePart_quarkPart (hg : g.IsSymm) (hγ : ∀ μ, (β * γ μ).IsHermitian)` proved by `rw [tracePart_apply, trace_quarkPart hg hγ]`, and derive `tracePart_quarkPart_of_diracEq` from it via `rw [h, mulVec_mulVec]`.
findings.issue: Only the on-shell `tracePart_quarkPart_of_diracEq` is stated; there is no off-shell `tracePart g (quarkPart β γ ψ Dψ) = ((star ψ ⬝ᵥ β *ᵥ diracOpApply g γ Dψ).re / Fintype.card n) • g`, even though `main` provides both `trace_quarkPart` and `trace_quarkPart_of_diracEq`, and the PR does state the gluon counterpart in general dimension before specialising.

summary: Six idempotence lemmas in MetricTrace.lean carry a hypothesis `(Fintype.card n : K) ≠ 0` that their statements do not need (four of them `@[simp]`), and the QCD file states the quark trace part only on shell although the off-shell version is a one-liner from the existing `trace_quarkPart`.
